name: Agata Nono
source:

Affiliation: Nude-Sense Shaolin Kenpo Club
Attributes: Imouto-type, childhood friend
Problems: She drinks too much milk, so she can't master her Drunken Fist-style

She has good manners, and a bright, friendly personality. Shunosuke was her "insta-bro", and around him, she's in Spoiled Sister Mode.
From the Nude-Sense Shaolin Kenpo Club, she has learned to use such attacks as the Chichikyoku-ken and Paikyokuken.
She claims to "become stronger if her breasts are sucked on". This is the experience known as the "Chichiyoi-ken", the most powerful ability known to the Nude-Sense Shaolin Kenpo Club. But she's nervous about learning it, because it is risky and seen as immoral to her Club.
Shunosuke is often helping her train with her Qigong exercises, and they always make each other feel better should practice accidentally go wrong, for which he has special training.
